recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant wording or reintroduce the old wasNotGiven/notGiven boolean; any future changes to not-done semantics should be handled under the later Pharmacy workflow issue family.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy issue asking that MedicationAdministration.status be marked as a modifier because of the stopped status, with a note to review overlap between status and MedicationAdministration.wasNotGiven.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed implementation commit was found, but git commit 5cbb08d6aab910f7be774d1ed00d6058bda1e7f6 directly applied the requested change by changing the then-authoritative MedicationAdministration spreadsheet row for MedicationAdministration.status from a blank Is Modifier cell to Y. The 2021 source rework in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 preserved this as isModifier=true in the current StructureDefinition.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active in source/fhir.ini. The current status value set includes stopped and not-done; MedicationAdministration.statusReason is documented for status=not-done. Later related issues FHIR-11091, FHIR-14022, and duplicate FHIR-13537 explain why the old wasNotGiven/notGiven boolean is no longer present. FHIR-11091 and FHIR-14022 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the active StructureDefinition already has MedicationAdministration.status marked as a modifier and the current model already represents the old not-given overlap through status/statusReason.

related_jiras.note: Later Published Pharmacy issue renamed MedicationAdministration.wasNotGiven to notGiven as part of harmonization and is already audited on the combined branch.
Later Published Pharmacy workflow-alignment issue removed the separate notGiven flag, added not-done to status, and introduced statusReason; it is already audited on the combined branch.
Duplicate issue requested adding not-done to status and removing notGiven, with resolution stating the work would be done as part of FHIR-14022.
